channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: How union members pay it forward
item.description: More and more workers want to join unions amid the high grocery prices, spiraling health care costs and other failures of today’s uncertain economy.

item.title: Independent police corruption investigations plummet by 70% in five years
item.description: The figures raise serious questions about the oversight of the police at a time when they are under huge scrutiny, and have prompted campaigners to slam a “broken” complaints system.

item.title: Trump’s plan for strikes on Iran carries major risks—and the US military knows it
item.description: The geopolitical consequences and political price will be his to bear, but could affect us all.

item.title: Will Mamdani abolish police, or simply make them obsolete?
item.description: What sets Mamdani apart from other progressive mayors who promised to be tough on police is a democratic socialist vision of a society that meets people’s needs.
